registered_before_run: This file is committed and pushed before scripts/research/prop_frontier_ev6m.py is run for the first time; the run's verdict.json names this file.
question: For a prop plan that passes the device-free automation filter (docs/research/prop-frontier-2026-11-12.md section 2) and has at least one fitting Stage-0-PASS leg, is the 6-month expected net USD per purchase positive, above the zero-edge null, on a book whose edge is distinguishable from zero?

scope.why_only_velotrade: The only firm that (a) passes the hard filter on first-party text, (b) lists instruments our Stage-0-PASS legs trade (SPY, QQQ, IWM, gold, silver, WTI; 1P velotrade.com/blog/velotrade-review, fetched 2026-11-12), (c) allows overnight and weekend holds, which every fitting leg needs (shortest p10 hold 6 h), and (d) has a drawdown shape prop_ev_sim.py can model (static). Blue Guardian passes (a) via MT5-EA-on-VPS but its 6% trailing drawdown cannot be simulated by prop_ev_sim.py (raises on non-static) -> not_attempted, recorded with a clears_when.
scope.plans: Velotrade CLASSIC 1-Step $5k and PRO 1-Step $5k (the two rulesets in config/prop_rulesets; CLASSIC 2-Step has no two-phase support in the simulator -> not_attempted).

book_selection: Every leg in config/strategies.yaml whose comms/strategy_evidence/<leg>.json decision_rule verdict is 'pass' (re-read 2026-11-12) AND whose underlying Velotrade lists first-party. One leg per (underlying, strategy family): iaum_pullback_1d and mgc_pullback_1d duplicate gld_pullback_1d's gold-pullback-1d family and are excluded; tqqq/qld/gdx/tlt/ief/scha underlyings are not listed by Velotrade; mes_trend_long_1d's record verdict is 'fail'; spy_pullback_1h and tlt_pullback_1h fail.

costs.source: Velotrade 1P velotrade.com/blog/velotrade-review (fetched 2026-11-12): commission 0.03% per side on index ETFs and stocks (0.01% on commodities: charging 0.03% on gold/silver/WTI legs is deliberately conservative); 'An overnight fee of 0.05% of the notional value applies to positions still open at 00:30 UTC on crypto, indices, commodities and single stocks, including weekends.' Slippage 3 bps RT as in RQ-20261112-09d2-06.

predicate: BUYABLE iff, for the primary book at the primary risk on that ruleset: min over seeds of ev_net_usd_per_life > 0 AND mean over seeds > the mean zero-edge-null EV (same ledgers re-centred to mean net R 0 under the same costs) AND the book's pooled net-R 95% CI lower bound (prop_gate.edge_ci, z 1.96) > 0. Every other book and the 1% risk arm are descriptive only and cannot make a plan buyable.
proxy_caveat: Ledgers are on the ETF the leg was measured on (GLD for gold, SLV for silver, USO for WTI); the Velotrade CFD on the same underlying is a proxy transfer. A BUYABLE verdict would still need the leg's own Stage-0 re-run on the CFD price series before any money moves.
on_pass: Buy-point condition in the memo's section 6 becomes live; operator decides the purchase.
on_fail: No purchase. The memo names the iteration that could change the answer (more trades per 6 months, lower overnight cost) as a pipeline item.
